species.name: Trout
why: Water 64°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 26–38 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 30 ft, cold below.

species.name: Kokanee
why: Water 64°F on top, warmer than they like, so they go deeper and into the shade.
Best water today is 36–42 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 30 ft, cold below.

species.name: Spotted bass
why: Water 64°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–28 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 30 ft, cold below.

species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 64°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 6–22 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 30 ft, cold below.
